statBlock.name: Adult Gold Dragon
statBlock.description: This dragon's sweeping whiskers and long sail-like wings give it a rippling flight. Gold dragons guard their privacy and sometimes help strangers while disguised.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The dragon can breathe air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The dragon may first use Frightful Presence. It then makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose any creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of the dragon. Each makes a DC 21 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that saves or whose fear ends gains immunity to this dragon's Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Use one of the following breaths.
Fire Breath. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. Failure deals 66 (12d10) fire damage. Success halves it.
Weakening Breath. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 21 Strength save. A creature that fails has disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saves for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Change Shape. The dragon magically changes into a humanoid or beast of its CR or lower or returns to dragon form. It returns to dragon form on death. The dragon chooses whether its equipment merges into the form or stays with it. In the new form, it keeps its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, speech, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and this action. Use the form's other statistics and capabilities. The dragon gains none of the form's class features, legendary actions, lair actions, or regional effects.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions. Spend them one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn. It regains them at the start of its turn. It can't use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or while surprised until it finishes its first turn.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.
sections.Lair actions:
While in its lair, the dragon can choose one option on initiative count 20, after other creatures on that count. It can't take a lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must first finish its first turn. It can't pick the same option in consecutive rounds.
Foresight. The dragon has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the next round's initiative count 20.
Dream Banishment. One creature the dragon can see within 120 ft. makes a DC 15 Charisma save. On a failure it is banished to a dream plane the dragon imagines. The creature can use its action to make a Charisma check contested by the dragon's, escaping if it wins. The banishment also ends on the next round's initiative count 20. The creature returns to the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more of these effects around the lair.
Dream Visitors. Within 6 miles of its lair, the dragon can speak telepathically in the dreams of a creature that understands a language and sleeps, trances, or enters reverie. The creature recalls the conversation on waking.
Warning Mist. Within 6 miles of the lair, opalescent mist doesn't obscure vision. If evil creatures approach the dragon or non-evil creatures in the mist, the mist takes eerie shapes as a warning.
Glowing Valuables. Gems and pearls within 1 mile of the lair cast dim light to 5 ft.
All these effects end immediately when the dragon dies.
sections.Variant spellcasting: Under the optional dragon spellcasting rule, choose 7 spells of 5th level or lower. The dragon uses Charisma to cast each once per day without material components. Its spell save DC is 21 and its spell attack bonus is +13. The DM chooses the spells.
